items.title: 5.4.4 Pani ki khusoosiyat par hydrogen bonding ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4.4, printed pages 102-103.

blocks.text: Barf ki banawat aur kam kasafat (density)

Pani ke molecules ki tetrahedral banawat hai, oxygen ke do lone pairs tetrahedron ke do konon par. Jab pani thanda ho kar barf banti hai to molecules zyada ba-qaida ho jate hain aur yeh qaidgi poori banawat mein phail jati hai; wasee hydrogen-bonded banawat mein khali jagahein ban jati hain. Isi liye jamne par pani 9 feesad zyada jagah leta hai aur us ki density ghat jati hai, to barf tairti hai. Barf ke is naam-nihad ghair-mamooli rawaiye ki wajah se machhliyan aur doosre jandar jami hui jheelon aur samandaron ke neeche zinda rehte hain: barf ki chadar kam density ki wajah se satah dhanp leti hai aur neeche ka pani mahol se mehfooz rehta hai. Glacier ka hissa isi wajah se tairta hai.
Pani ki specific heat capacity zyada hai apni munfarid molecular banawat ki wajah se, jo mazboot hydrogen bonds ki ijazat deti hai.
Ghair-mamooli heat of vaporization aur boiling point

Group 16 ke hydrides ki enthalpy of vaporization H2S se H2Po tak ba-qaida barhti hai, kyunke yeh molecules kamzor London dispersion forces se bandhe hain jo group mein neeche S se Po tak atomic size barhne se mazboot hoti hain. Agar pani is rujhan par chalta to us ki heat of vaporization group mein sab se kam hoti; is ke bajaye pani ki enthalpy of vaporization sab se zyada hai, 41 kJ fi mol, kyunke yeh ghair-mamooli taur par hydrogen bonded hai, jo us ke molecules ke darmiyan forces torna aur use bukharat banana mushkil karta hai. Pani ka boiling point bhi group 16 ke baqi hydrides se numayan taur par zyada hai: pani ke molecules alag karne ke liye darkar energy bohat zyada hai, to use ubalne ke liye zyada darja hararat chahiye.

Pani ki surface tension aur viscosity bhi bohat zyada hain. Surface tension satah ke molecules par neeche ki taraf khinchao hai, jo satah ko tani hui banata hai; yeh khinchao androoni molecules ki hydrogen bonds se kashish se aata hai. Viscosity liquid ki behne mein mazahmat hai; pani bohat se liquids se zyada viscous hai, hexane aur ethanol jaise chhote hydrocarbons aur alcohols samet, phir apne mazboot hydrogen bonds ki wajah se. Alcohols hydrogen bonds bana sakte hain, magar pani se kahin kam aur kamzor; hydrocarbons bilkul nahi bana sakte.

blocks.alt: Baen: surkh oxygen atoms ka chhatta, har ek do sleti hydrogens ke saath, nuqtedar neele hydrogen bonds se khule chhe-koniya chhallon mein jura, barf ke tairne par notes ke saath. Daen: hydrides H2O se H2Po ke muqable boiling point ya heat of vaporization ka graph, H2S se ba-qaida barhti neeli lakeer, sleti nuqtedar tawseeh jo dikhati hai pani kahan girta, aur pani ka surkh nuqta bohat oopar.
blocks.caption: Barf ki khuli banawat aur group 16 hydrides mein pani ka ghair-mamooli boiling point aur heat of vaporization (Figures 5.6 aur 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; oonchaiyan schematic).
blocks.long_description: Barf mein har oxygen apne parosiyon se ba-qaida tetrahedral jaal mein hydrogen bonded hai jo khali jagah se bhara hai, to barf pani se kam ghani hai aur tairti hai, neeche ke pani ko mehfooz rakhte hue. Group 16 mein neeche hydrides size ke saath London forces barhne se batadreej oonche darja hararat par ubalte hain; pani sab se neeche hona chahiye magar sab se oopar hai, 100 degrees C par 41 kJ fi mol heat of vaporization ke saath ubalta hai, kyunke pehle us ke hydrogen bonds torne hote hain. Wahi bonds us ki heat capacity, surface tension aur viscosity barhate hain.

blocks.prompt: CH3CH3 (-89 degrees C) aur CH3OH (65 degrees C) aur butane (0 degrees C) aur propanol (97 degrees C) ke boiling point farq 154 aur 97 degrees hain. Wazahat karein ke molecules bare hone par farq kyun sukarta hai, aur acetic acid khalis halat mein dimers kyun banata hai magar pani mein nahi.
blocks.explanation: Alcohol ka izafi boiling point us ke hydrogen bonds se aata hai, jo har jore mein taqreeban utna hi jorte hain, jabke hydrocarbon zanjeer ki London forces us ki lambai ke saath barhti hain. Bare jore mein zanjeer ki London forces kul kashish ka bara hissa hain, to hydrogen bond chhota nisbati farq banata hai. Khalis acetic acid ke molecules apne COOH groups ke darmiyan do hydrogen bonds se jora bante hain; pani mein acid ke O-H aur C=O groups is ke bajaye gird ke bohat se pani ke molecules se hydrogen bond banate hain, to dimers toot jate hain.

items: Barf: khali jagahon wala ba-qaida hydrogen-bonded jaal, 9 feesad zyada hajm, kam density, tairti hai aur neeche ka pani mehfooz rakhti hai; pani ki specific heat capacity bhi zyada hai.

Pani ki heat of vaporization (41 kJ fi mol) aur boiling point group 16 ke rujhan se bohat oopar hain, aur us ki surface tension aur viscosity zyada hain, sab wasee hydrogen bonding ki wajah se (alcohols kam, hydrocarbons bilkul nahi).
